ReplacementContent: "  - **Premium Sync Pop-up Overlay Modal**: Implemented a highly aesthetic, custom glassmorphism pop-up overlay window modal built on `framer-motion` (`AnimatePresence` and custom scale/fade transitions). Clicking the refresh button triggers a scale-in popup with a spinning emerald ring loader. Upon a successful sync, the pop-up dynamically transitions into a satisfying scaling green checkmark animation that scales up and wipes clean using SVG path morphing, followed by a soft fade-out overlay closing.\n\n---"
TargetContent: "  - **Animated Sync Refresh Controls**: Created an async `handleSyncRefresh` handler bound to the KOT & Billing toolbar Sync/Refresh buttons. It initializes a state hook (`isSyncing`) that dynamically applies a spinning animation (`animate-spin`) to the `RefreshCcw` icon for the background database sync. To guarantee the animation is fully visible even on ultra-fast local networks or localhost setups, added an enforced minimum duration of `800ms` so that the spinner rotates satisfyingly and premium feedback is visible every single time.\n\n---"
